note: Track legato (guitar-techniques), step 3: the trill with fingers 2 and 4 on the B string (legato-trill at level intermediate, fingers 24). The old Stage selector of tempos is now moves (60 to 84 bpm), and the fingers 2-4 legato copy is folded in. One block of 4 minutes: the drill, the goal, and a care line.

exercise.title: Hammer and pull, fingers 2 and 4
exercise.why: Fingers 2 and 4 have a fret between them and finger 4 is the weakest, so a trill on that pair alone trains finger 4 to land on its fret and pull off cleanly.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome at {{=bpm}} and follow the tab. Pick once, then hammer finger 4 on and pull it off to finger 2, one note per beat, with no more picking.
Practice until the pulled-off note is as loud as the hammered one.
_Rest your hand when it gets tired, then go again._
